verdict.rationale: Convertio's developer portal lists a first-party "CLI: Our Command Line Interface" alongside its API and official wrappers, so an official CLI appears to exist. The evidence is a single one-line mention, with nothing on installation, commands, or how it fits AI-native workflows. Missing for 10: CLI documentation (install, commands, auth via API key), any agent/AI-native or scripting-oriented features, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the CLI works and is maintained.
